metadata.description: Rotifer plugin collection for Cursor and Git-based marketplace installs

plugins.name: rotifer
plugins.description: The Rotifer Protocol plugin — three Skills plus the Rotifer MCP server. Create your first Agent from a template (hello), route yourself to the right capability (assistant), and rank an Agent's Genes against live Arena data to swap in stronger ones (evolve). Ranking is the automatic part; every replacement waits for your approval and can be rolled back.
